title: Bain Capital’s head of real estate uses this strategy to counter the economy’s ‘cocktail of disruption'
summary: In a recent interview, Ryan Cotton, the head of real estate at Bain Capital, discussed the multifaceted challenges currently facing the economy, which he describes as a 'cocktail of disruption.' He emphasized the importance of adaptive strategies in navigating these turbulent times, particularly in the real estate sector. Cotton's insights reflect a broader trend among investors who are re-evaluating their approaches to market volatility and uncertainty.
